report_name: $2.56M Stolen from Ngrave Wallet Users via Phishing Attack

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Attackers sent push notifications containing a link to a counterfeit Ngrave website. The notification falsely warned of a new device synchronization in Moscow to create a sense of urgency and trick users into clicking the link.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The attackers abused the trusted relationship between users and the Ngrave LIQUID app by compromising a third-party push notification service to send seemingly legitimate alerts.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious Link
attack_patterns.description: The attack's success relied on users clicking a malicious link within the fraudulent push notification, which led them to the phishing site where their recovery phrases were harvested.

campaigns.name: Ngrave Push Notification Phishing Campaign
campaigns.description: A sophisticated phishing campaign where attackers compromised a third-party push notification provider to send fraudulent security alerts to Ngrave LIQUID app users, luring them to a phishing site to steal their 24-word recovery phrases. The campaign resulted in the theft of approximately $2.56 million in Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and other assets.
campaigns.objective: Steal cryptocurrency by harvesting user recovery phrases.

identities.name: Ngrave
identities.description: Belgian hardware wallet company whose LIQUID companion app users were targeted in a phishing attack via a compromised third-party push notification service.

identities.name: Ngrave Wallet Users
identities.description: A class of individuals who use the Ngrave hardware wallet and were the primary victims of the phishing campaign, losing approximately $2.56 million in cryptocurrency.

infrastructure.name: Counterfeit Ngrave Website
infrastructure.description: A phishing website, visually identical to the official Ngrave site, used to prompt users to enter their 24-word recovery phrase.

infrastructure.name: Compromised Push Notification Service
infrastructure.description: A compromised third-party service used by the attackers to send fraudulent push notifications through the official Ngrave LIQUID app channel.

infrastructure.name: Attacker Cryptocurrency Wallets
infrastructure.description: Attacker-controlled cryptocurrency addresses where approximately $2.56 million in stolen assets were transferred.
